sloka: अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथा वृत्तं तवान्तिके ।चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव ।। ५.६५.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: abhijñānaṁ ca me dattaṁ yathā vṛttaṁ tavāntike ।citrakūṭe mahāprājña vāyasaṁ prati rāghava ।। 5.65.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "O wise one, with your ring given her, she told me an anecdote of a crow that took place at Chitrakuta.
